notes: §2002:7.2.2 SR4: a free-form directive may be followed only by space characters and an optional inline comment. The same operand check serves both reference formats (CompilerDirectiveLine.TryParse splits off the inline comment; the format's own parse refuses any other trailing word). kb/Work PB5600: `>>FLAG-85 ALL ON JUNK` and `>>FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC ALL ON` were accepted in silence and are refused (COBOL1622) at 2002 and 2014.
